title: NextOne Observer EvidenceEnvelope v1
description: Evidence-only observation contract. An EvidenceEnvelope is an observation, never an authorization decision. See INV-01..INV-12.

evidence_id.description: Stable identifier of the observation object, not of any authorization decision. Deterministically derived as 'ev1:' + SHA-256 over the canonical identity payload (subject, target, observed_state, observed_value, observed_at, provenance); see docs/EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.md. Distinct from the integrity digest.

observed_state.description: Observation state only. No authorization semantics.

observed_value.description: The observed catalog value. Required to be non-null iff observed_state is KNOWN. This is an observed value, never an authorized value.

observed_at.description: Semantically valid RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time in the canonical UTC representation (Z suffix required, enforced by both the pattern and the active date-time format check; impossible calendar/time values such as month 13 or February 30 are rejected at schema validation, before integrity verification). Timestamp-validation refinement.

temporal_basis.description: Evidence-only temporal meaning. MUST NOT contain FRESH, STALE, EGA freshness thresholds, max-age policy, or any authorization validity decision (INV-03).

source_confidence.description: Source-supplied confidence, preserved as-is. null when the source supplies none; confidence is never invented.

confidence_semantics.description: Explains how to read source_confidence, e.g. 'not_supplied'.

integrity.description: Deterministic integrity reference over the canonicalized envelope payload excluding the integrity object (INV-07). Integrity is not authorization.
